name: 无限刃
description: 对2格内1个敌人造成真实伤害。你可以改为失去1点生命，再次发动此技能。伤害倍率为100%/150%/200%攻击力，每击杀1名角色提升1级；再次发动时会重新选择目标。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var source = context.piece; var killTag = source.statusTags && source.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'shishio-kills'; }); var kills = killTag ? (killTag.intensity || 0) : 0; var mult = kills >= 2 ? 2.0 : kills >= 1 ? 1.5 : 1.0; var target = selectTarget({ type: 'piece', range: 2, filter: 'enemy' }); if (!target || target.needsTargetSelection) return target; var dist = Math.abs(target.x - source.x) + Math.abs(target.y - source.y); if (dist > 2) return { success: false, message: '目标超出无限刃范围（2格内）' }; if (target.currentHp <= 0) return { success: false, message: '目标已出局' }; var dmg = Math.floor(source.attack * mult); dealDamage(source, target, dmg, 'true'); addSkillById(source.instanceId, 'shishio-infinite-blade-recast'); return { success: true, message: source.name + ' 发动无限刃，对' + target.name + ' 造成 ' + dmg + ' 点真实伤害（' + Math.floor(mult * 100) + '%），可再次发动无限刃' }; }
